annotations.title: Look up whether REWORK issued a credential

description: Check whether REWORK actually ISSUED a credential - not just whether its signature verifies. A forged-but-well-formed token fails this; a real one returns its issuance record and the CURRENT OpenTimestamps receipt, which may have been upgraded to a Bitcoin confirmation since issue. Pass the credential (its sha256 is the lookup key) or the digest directly. Workflow attestations and Hugging Face credentials are recorded. Certificate, video-receipt and passport credentials are signed afresh on every download and have no issuance record: pass the credential itself (not its digest) and the answer says so, with the certificate it names looked up instead.

credential.description: The VC-JWT. Hashed locally and never sent anywhere. For a certificate credential, the certificate id it names (already public) is looked up as well.

digest.description: sha256 hex of the credential, if you already have it.

name: lookup_rework_attestation

assurance_note.description: The ceiling on what this result proves. Read it before relying on the result.

certificate.description: Present for a certificate credential: the certificate it names, looked up by id.

found.description: Whether REWORK has that certificate; null when it could not be read.

revoked.description: Whether it has been revoked; null when not found or not read.

claim.description: For a repository-control challenge: the claim's state now (status, verdict, lease). Only a status of verified shows control today.

credential_type.description: The kind of credential: from REWORK's record when one was found, otherwise as the credential states it (unverified).

github.description: For a Hugging Face join: the GitHub Actions run, as REWORK recorded it.

huggingface.description: For a Hugging Face credential: the repository (and for a join, the exact content state) REWORK recorded.

issued.description: Whether REWORK has a record of issuing a credential with this digest. Null when REWORK keeps no per-digest record for this kind of credential, so the lookup can neither confirm nor deny it.

timestamp.description: The OpenTimestamps receipt as REWORK holds it now. Only a status of confirmed is anchored in Bitcoin.

title: Look up whether REWORK issued a credential
